title: VINICIUS BLAMES THE WORLD CUP FOR HIS SLOW START. MOURINHO DISAGREES!
description:
One league goal in eight games. Vinicius has an explanation.

Real Madrid's winger has lost his starting place to new signing Yan Diomande. In Singapore he said he trained less after the World Cup, and that he felt overwhelmed by summer transfer talk. Honest, at least.

Mourinho's take: he said Vinicius should not have said it, but that he does not criticise honesty. The message underneath: win your place back. The honesty gets a thumbs up. The excuse does not.

So who is right here? Vinicius for owning up, or Mourinho for telling him to stop explaining and start scoring? Pick a side in the comments.
